handover.summary: 12-page handover for Sample Shine Mobile Detailing and a zip of 23 files (1 left out); 3 statements for the customer to confirm.

left.reason: Could not be added this time; ask us and we will send it separately.

thisWeek.title: Check your site on your phone
thisWeek.detail: Open sample-shine.autocaregeniushub.com on your phone, tap Call and Book, and read every section once. Tell us anything that is off.

thisWeek.title: Sign off the claims list
thisWeek.detail: Read the 3 statements on the Claims sign-off page and confirm or correct each one.

thisWeek.title: Paste your Google profile copy
thisWeek.detail: Paste the description and services from words.pdf into your Google Business Profile; paste-ready.txt has the same words to copy.

thisWeek.title: Put your link everywhere
thisWeek.detail: Add sample-shine.autocaregeniushub.com to your Google Business Profile, your social bios, your invoices and your email signature.

thisWeek.title: Ask five recent customers for a review
thisWeek.detail: Text them your Google review link. Never offer anything in return: Google does not allow it.

checklist.task: Tick off the 5 things on the "This week" page.
Share sample-shine.autocaregeniushub.com with your regular customers by text or email.
Post the first of your 12 Google profile posts from the copy deck; one a week lasts three months.
Post post-1.png with its caption from captions.txt.
Ask every happy customer this week for a Google review with your review link.
Reply to every new review, good or bad; the copy deck has reply starters.
Take the photos on your shot list: A wide shot of the van at a driveway; Before and after of a seat; You at work.
Post your next Google profile update.
Check Bookings and Inquiries in the app for new bookings and messages.
Swap in your newest photos: Edit, click a photo, upload.
Tell us what you would like changed: reply to any email from us.
